coverage.note: Provider season statistics; ratings and percentiles are within this league and role.

limitations: Provider ratings are opaque and not comparable across leagues.
Percentiles are within this league and role cohort; no cross-league ranking.
No contracts, wages, fees or release clauses are claimed.
No xG/xA, progressive passes, carries, pressures, aerial wins or crosses are in the feed.
Role families come from starting-XI grids; leagues without grids use the provider group.

rose_meta.method_note: Two Nightingale rose figures: an all-round overall set and a role-specific position set, both against the same league and role-family cohort. Percentiles are directional; missing values are not zero.
